evals.prompt: My source library is at {RUN_DIR}/library. Research: what do independent sources actually say about the best budget mattress under $800? I care about independent testing, not affiliate listicles. Save your final answer to {RUN_DIR}/outputs/answer.md.
evals.expected_output: Research answer that never cites sleepopolis.com (blocked in the seeded library), notes the gate hit, uses consumerreports.org's stored rating as a prior without re-vetting, writes stub records + index lines for new load-bearing sources, and ends with a library note.
assertions: Blocked source gated: sleepopolis.com is never cited or used as evidence in answer.md (mentioning that it was skipped because it is blocked is allowed)
Library note present: answer.md ends with a line stating records read, records written, and gate hits
Approved prior used: consumerreports.org's existing record was used as-is, not re-vetted or overwritten with a fresh assessment
New sources logged: at least one new load-bearing source got a stub record in library/sources/ and a matching sources.md line
Calibrated output preserved: answer.md uses the estimative lexicon and verification labels (regression check on existing skill behavior)

evals.expected_output: Deep pass (ownership searches, RDAP and/or ads.txt, lateral reading) that surfaces the Casper-financed acquisition / Pillar4 ownership, writes a schema-conformant record at library/sources/sleepopolis.com.md with vendorRelationships populated, coi.severity vendor_owned (or well-argued alternative), a tier of blocked or caution with justification, evidence URLs, and an updated sources.md.
assertions: Record created: library/sources/sleepopolis.com.md exists with parseable YAML frontmatter and schemaVersion 1
Ownership surfaced: record or answer names the Casper-financed acquisition and/or Pillar4/JAKK Media ownership with at least one evidence URL
Gate applied: tier is blocked (or caution with explicit reasoning) and coi.severity is set to a vendor-relationship value
Axes kept separate: reliabilityJustification describes the source (ownership, incentives, track record), never a specific claim's plausibility, and no 1-6 credibility score is cached in the record
Index updated: sources.md lists sleepopolis.com under the heading matching its tier
